title: Batch run summary v1 (batch-run/1)
description: DRAFT for S1-01. One body for each run of a GCP batch job. The job sends it to POST /api/batch/runs after the publish step (S1-03). The trace ID is not in the body: it goes in the W3C traceparent HTTP header (S1-05). Field names of a record are the same as the contract v1.1 Trace record, so the shared judge code reads them without a change. See llm-metrics-standard.md. Rules that JSON Schema cannot express are listed in schema/README.md; the backend (S1-02) enforces them.

schema_version.description: Fixed value. The backend rejects any other version.

use_case_id.description: SOURCE: a constant in the job configuration. The ID of the use case in the YAML registry (S2-01). It must be the use case of the API key.

run_id.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in (for example the Cloud Run execution name, the Workflows execution ID, or <job>-<business date>). A stable ID of this run: a retry of the send, or a rerun of the same run, sends the same ID. A new run sends a new ID.

status.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. 'completed': the job published all its results. 'partial': the job published, but some requests gave no usable output. 'failed': the job did not publish.

completed_at.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The time when the job published the results, or the time when the job failed. UTC, ISO 8601, with 'Z'.

request_count.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The number of model requests in the run (the input rows that the job sent to Gemini).

failed_count.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The number of requests that gave no usable output (error, timeout, empty or unparsable response). Not more than request_count. A safety block is not a failure: it is a record with refused=true.

model.description: SOURCE: the Gemini model ID that the job called, for example 'gemini-2.5-flash'. If the job calls more than one model, the model of the main generation step.

sample.description: How the job selected the records.

method.description: Only uniform random sampling in v1.

size.description: SOURCE: the job setting SAMPLE_SIZE (default 50). The configured sample size, not the number of records sent. The backend compares it with the registry (8 to 200).

records.description: The sampled records, with PII replaced by placeholders. Empty in identity-only mode (SEND_RECORDS off), when the job failed, or when request_count is 0.

records_reason.description: Why records is empty. Required when records is empty and request_count is more than 0. Not allowed when records has items. 'records_not_approved': identity-only mode. 'job_failed': status is 'failed' (PROPOSED, not yet in the standard).

allOf.description: A run with no requests has no records.
Empty records with requests: a reason is required.
A failed run sends no records, and its reason is job_failed. Other runs never use job_failed.

redactedText.description: Free text. Phone numbers, email addresses and national ID numbers are replaced by [PHONE], [EMAIL] and [NATIONAL_ID] before the send (S1-03).

record_id.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The ID of the request inside the run, for example the row number or the Batch API request key. Unique in the run. Never a customer ID, account number or phone number.

question.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in (which part of the prompt). The instruction that the model got, without the source material and without the system prompt. Redacted.

answer.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. The output text of the model for this request. Redacted. Can be empty only when refused is true (blocked, no output).

retrieval_context.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in (which part of the prompt). The source material that the model got, for example the document that it summarized. [] if the prompt has no source material.

doc_id.description: An ID of the source document. Never a customer ID.

title.description: A short title of the source document. Can be empty. Redacted.

text.description: The text of the source document as the model got it. Redacted.

tool_calls.description: Optional. Only if the job uses Gemini function calls. The judge treats each output as source material.

output.description: The function result that the model got. Any JSON value. Redacted.

refused.description: SOURCE: GCP job developer to fill in. true if the model declined or was blocked: finishReason SAFETY / PROHIBITED_CONTENT / BLOCKLIST / SPII, promptFeedback.blockReason set, or a clear refusal text.

latency_s.description: SOURCE: the time of the Gemini call in seconds, measured by the job. null for the Gemini Batch API (no time for each request). Never 0.
